wordmark.purpose: The name ras.ruchi in Rozha One 400 across the home card header and collection page names; 21px in the site header. Its full stop is centred with measured spacing.

display.purpose: Section headings, collection names on bands, the contact heading.

title.purpose: Design names in rows, study titles and subheads.

tagline.purpose: Collection taglines and the In her words quotes, in Bodoni Moda italic; the only use of Bodoni Moda.

lead.purpose: Section ledes and introductions, held to 40ch.

label.purpose: Printed particulars: navigation, seasons, techniques, credit terms, link labels.

shade.purpose: Measured hex shade codes, counts, figure captions; sized to fit a 95px swatch column and never wrapped under a swatch.

devanagari.purpose: The Devanagari name रसरुचि only, in Rozha One, the same face as the Latin wordmark.

shadows.name: card-stock
shadows.purpose: Every card, study sheet and keyword tag at rest (token --card-shadow; deeper in dark mode).

shadows.name: cloth-rest
shadows.purpose: filter on every swatch, follows the pinked outline (token --cloth-shadow).

shadows.name: cloth-lifted
shadows.purpose: filter on a handled, focused or selected swatch and during the deal entrance (token --cloth-shadow-lifted).

shadows.name: punched-hole
shadows.purpose: The 15px ring hole cut through each card.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Lifts, crossfades, underline draws, the deal entrance, view-transition morphs.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Declared for symmetric moves; rarely used.

motion.name: swatch-lift
motion.purpose: Swatch translate, rotate, scale and shadow.

motion.name: deal
motion.purpose: One entrance per load: swatches fall from 26px above at -9deg.

motion.name: room-crossfade
motion.purpose: Room window swap when a swatch is chosen.

motion.name: band-morph
motion.purpose: View-transition from collection card band to page header.

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a sheet of white card stock lying on grey mill board, punched with a ring hole, with cut cloth glued to it and its particulars printed beside it in tracked caps. The work is the colour; the interface is board, card, ink and print. A collection announces itself with one printed colour band across the top of its card, the way a mill heads a range. Swatches are square, pinked along every edge, tilted a fraction of a degree as if placed by hand, and they lift off the card when handled.

Density is a catalogue's: many small swatches in strict grids, generous card margins, long reading lines held to about 62 characters. Type does three jobs and keeps them apart: Rozha One's high-contrast fat face for card headers and the wordmark, in Latin and Devanagari alike, the way a textile label or fashion masthead is set; Jost for reading; and Jost's small tracked caps for everything a mill would print (labels, seasons, counts, measured hex shade codes). Corners are square everywhere; the only circles are punched holes and colour dots.

Motion is physical and sparse: swatches are dealt onto the card once on load, lift and tilt under the hand, and a collection's band morphs from its card into its page header. Under reduced motion everything is static.
keyCharacteristics: Grey mill board ground, white card stock above it, charcoal board and dark stock at night.
Square, pinked-edge cloth swatches with a soft two-layer drop shadow and a slight per-swatch tilt.
One printed colour band per collection, drawn from that collection's own cloth.
Rozha One for headers, the wordmark and रसरुचि; Bodoni Moda italic for taglines and quotes only; Jost for reading and for printed caps.
Zero radius; a punched ring hole on every card.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: A band colour belongs to one collection and appears only where that collection is named. Never use a band as a generic accent, button fill or section background.

rules.name: The Cloth Is The Colour Rule
rules.body: Interface colour stays in the board, card and ink greys; saturated colour on screen comes from photographs of cloth and from collection bands.

rules.name: The Printed Caps Rule
rules.body: Jost's small tracked caps are for printed particulars that sit beside or below what they describe: a design's technique, a swatch's shade, a collection's season. They never sit above a heading as an introductory line.

rules.name: The Centred Dot Rule
rules.body: The full stop in "ras.ruchi" sits centred, with equal space to the "s" and the "r". Its spacing is measured from rendered Rozha One at hero, phone and header sizes: 0.01em before and -0.01em after. Rozha One has no optical sizes, so one em-based value holds everywhere, the 21px header logo included. Re-measure if the face or size changes; never leave the default spacing.

rules.name: The Tucked Capital Rule
rules.body: Rozha One has no kerning, so a capital W or V leaves a visible gap before the lowercase letter after it ("W rite"). Every piece of display text (design names, collection names, study titles and headings, section titles, the footer heading) passes through the kern helper, which tucks the next letter in by -0.04em after W or V. Rozha's capitals are short, close to its x-height, so the tuck stays light to avoid collisions.

rules.name: The Measured Shade Rule
rules.body: A shade code is a hex value measured from the actual cloth photograph. Never print a code that was not measured.

rules.name: The Three Layers Rule
rules.body: Board, card, cloth. Nothing else floats; there are no modals, glows or decorative elevations.

rules.name: The Cloth Lifts Rule
rules.body: Elevation changes are a response to handling: cloth lifts (up 6px, tilting a further 1.5deg; selected, up 12px, 2.5deg, scale 1.04) and study sheets rise 3-4px on hover.

dos: Do put every new surface on card stock over mill board, with a punched ring hole at the card's top-left.
Do show cloth as square, pinked swatches with the cloth shadow and a small per-swatch tilt.
Do head anything about a collection with that collection's band colour and nothing else's.
Do set printed particulars (season, technique, counts, shade codes) in Jost tracked caps beside or below what they describe.
Do pass every display string through the W/V kern helper, and keep the wordmark's full stop centred with measured spacing.
Do use ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for lifts, crossfades and underline draws, and keep everything static under reduced motion.
Do keep text on mustard Pause bands near-black and on every other band warm off-white.
donts: Don't round any corner; the only circles are holes and collection dots.
Don't use a band colour as a general accent, button fill or section background.
Don't place a small caps line above a heading as an introduction.
Don't print a shade code that was not measured from the cloth.
Don't add a fourth depth layer: no modals, glows, floating panels or decorative shadows beyond board, card and cloth.
Don't lay work out as uniform project tiles with no card, band or swatch structure.
